import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import CountVectorizer
from sklearn.ensemble import GradientBoostingClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Set random seed for reproducibility
np.random.seed(42)

# Load datasets
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/en_train.csv", low_memory=False)
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/en_test_2.csv", low_memory=False)
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/en_sample_submission_2.csv", low_memory=False)

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")
print(f"Sample submission shape: {sample_sub.shape}")

# Create id column for training (concatenate sentence_id and token_id)
train_df["id"] = (
    train_df["sentence_id"].astype(str) + "_" + train_df["token_id"].astype(str)
)

# Extract target column
y_train = train_df["after"].values


# Create features - use character n-grams since some tokens contain special symbols
def create_text_features(texts):
    vectorizer = CountVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb", ngram_range=(2, 4), max_features=10000
    )
    X = vectorizer.fit_transform(texts)
    return X.toarray()


# Prepare training features
train_texts = train_df["before"].fillna("")
X_train = create_text_features(train_texts)

# Split training data into train/val (hold out validation)
X_val_idx = np.random.permutation(len(X_train))[: int(0.2 * len(X_train))]
X_train_final = X_val_idx == True
mask = X_train_final.astype(int)

X_train = X_train[mask]
y_train = y_train[mask]
X_val = X_train[~mask]
y_val = y_train[~mask]

print(f"Final train size: {X_train.shape[0]}")
print(f"Validation size: {X_val.shape[0]}")

# Train the model
model = GradientBoostingClassifier(
    n_estimators=200, max_depth=5, learning_rate=0.1, min_samples_leaf=20
)
model.fit(X_train, y_train)

# Validate on held-out set
val_predictions = model.predict(X_val)
validation_accuracy = 100 * sum(val_predictions == y_val) / len(y_val)
print(f"Validation Accuracy: {validation_accuracy:.4f}%")

# Now prepare predictions for all training data (for sanity check only, not used for final score)
all_predictions = model.predict(
    X_train_final.astype(int).reshape(-1, 1) if np.any(mask) else X_train
)

# Generate predictions for test set
test_ids = test_df["id"].values
test_before = test_df["before"].fillna("")
X_test = create_text_features(test_before)
test_predictions = model.predict(X_test)

# Create submission file
submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_ids, "after": test_predictions})
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv with {len(submission)} rows")

# Also validate against sample format
print(f"\nChecking submission format...")
print(submission.head())
